sn35.164:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā mahākoṭṭhito bhagavantaṃ etadavoca: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā …pe…
sn35.164:1.3: yo kho koṭṭhita anattā, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.164:1.5: cakkhuṃ kho koṭṭhita anattā, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.164:1.6: rūpā anattā, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.164:1.7: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattā, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.164:1.8: cakkhusamphasso anattā, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.164:1.9: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassa paccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattā, tatra te chando pahātabbo. sotaṃ …pe… ghānaṃ …pe…
sn35.164:1.11: mano anattā, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.164:1.15: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattā, tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.164:1.16: yo kho koṭṭhita anattā, tatra te chando pahātabboti.
